title: Key
description:
**Tooltip**
A key for a Lock.
**Can be used as**
A tool that gives you access to a vehicle, storage or door lock.
**Craftable**
yes, but you need the original key.
**Ingredients**
iron scrap
**Console Code**
BP\_LockKey
**Weight**
0.0 Pounds / 0.0 Kilograms / 0 Bananas
**Vehicle key Spawn**
Some vehicles spawn with their key in the ignition - if a vehicle does not spawn with a key in it, the key can generally be found in a building nearby. Also there is a chance that a car key can spawn in zombie corpses.
**Some funfacts**
**No more hot wiring required.**
You can label a key for better organisation.
Copy the key, in case you lost one or share it with your friends.
Don't forget to take the key with you.

title: Redford Container Key
description:
This key looks like it could unlock a shipping container.
A tag hanging off the keyring reads "Property of the Redford Fire Department".

title: Redford Substation Key
description: A key marked for use on the Redford Substation Building.
